title: Texture Extend Modes
summary: Official Derivative reference for texture extend modes, covering how U, V, and W coordinates outside [0,1] are handled through Hold, Zero, Repeat, and Mirror behavior.
guidance: Use this article when a plan needs predictable texture behavior outside the [0,1] coordinate range.
Choose Hold to clamp outside coordinates to the nearest image edge color.
Choose Zero when samples outside the texture should become transparent black.
Choose Repeat when outside coordinates should wrap by removing the integer portion.
Choose Mirror when repeated regions should alternate flipped orientation for each odd or even integer span.
Set U, V, and W extend modes independently when the sampled texture type supports them.
